site_evaluations.name: Shackleton Sunlit Rim Alpha
site_evaluations.rationale: Elevated South Pole crater rim crest (+1720 m LOLA) with quasi-continuous solar illumination (>85% of lunar year) adjacent to cold-trap volatiles.
site_evaluations.primary_resources: Permanently shadowed crater water-ice (<2 km), near-continuous solar power, Earth RF visibility
site_evaluations.finding_summary: Uploaded map has low spatial correlation (r=0.08) with baseline moon; verify coordinates/projection.

site_evaluations.name: Connecting Ridge Basecamp
site_evaluations.rationale: Broad topographic saddle linking Shackleton and de Gerlache rims; combines flat landing terrain with dual cold-trap access.
site_evaluations.primary_resources: Anorthositic regolith (oxygen extraction), solar ridge exposure, low-grade rover traverse routes
site_evaluations.finding_summary: Uploaded map has low spatial correlation (r=0.08) with baseline moon; verify coordinates/projection.

site_evaluations.name: Malapert Massif Southern Bench
site_evaluations.rationale: High-altitude highland terrace maintaining uninterrupted direct line-of-sight to Earth for autonomous telemetry and crewed comms.
site_evaluations.primary_resources: Uninterrupted Earth communications relay vantage, ilmenite/anorthosite regolith, thermal stability
site_evaluations.finding_summary: Uploaded map has low spatial correlation (r=0.08) with baseline moon; verify coordinates/projection.

earth_crater_matches.name: Roter Kamm Crater
earth_crater_matches.ice_analog_notes: High rim-to-depth ratio (0.30) maximizes polar horizon solar capture next to sheltered interior cold traps.
earth_crater_matches.geology_notes: Exposed crystalline gneiss rim rising ~40-90 m above surrounding plains with aeolian sand infill.

earth_crater_matches.name: Tenoumer Crater
earth_crater_matches.ice_analog_notes: Prominent raised rim (0.28) provides high solar rim vantage while shielding floor deposits from low-angle insolation.
earth_crater_matches.geology_notes: Circular impact structure in Precambrian gneiss with prominent upturned sedimentary/crystalline collar.

earth_crater_matches.name: Wolfe Creek Crater
earth_crater_matches.ice_analog_notes: Flat infilled floor indicates post-impact trapping; subsurface moisture/ice pockets persist beneath gypsum/regolith fill.
earth_crater_matches.geology_notes: Well-preserved quartzite crater with steep inner talus slopes and flat central evaporite pan.
